parsed.title: Anima Video Generation Export Boost
parsed.oneLiner: Users can play a quick Simula game to earn an extra Anima video generation credit when they hit the daily free limit.

newMechanic.name: Anima Generation Limits
newMechanic.description: Introduce a daily limit of 1 free video animation per day, with additional exports costing 1 Anima Video Credit.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Protects high-COGS GPU resources on video generation while providing a clear monetization path for free users.

parsed.trigger: When the user taps the generate button with 0 Anima Video Credits remaining.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying free tier users who have exhausted their daily video generation limit.

offer.title: Out of Anima Credits
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to get 1 Anima Video Credit and export now.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Video generation limits are completely distinct from the main Luzia+ core reasoning or chat features, ensuring subscribers still maintain exclusive access to faster models and advanced custom services.

kpis.holdout: User-level randomized holdout group, 10% allocation, evaluated over 28 days.

risks: Introducing limits on video generation may cause initial user backlash, similar to Duolingo's Energy change.
High video generation infrastructure costs might exceed ad payout in low-eCPM regions if not geographically capped.

evidence.quote: Animate Tool Screen (tab) is a place users return to (6 visits during exploration)
Upload the pic you want to animate

callouts.text: Users upload their picture and pick an animation option on this tab.

storyboard.caption: Currently, users can select styles like Clapping or Walking on the Anima Tool screen.

callouts.text: Shows that the user has 0 Anima Credits remaining today.
Generate Video is locked when the balance is 0.

storyboard.caption: We introduce a credit counter and block video generation once the daily allowance is exhausted.

callouts.text: Tapping this opens the Simula game invitation.

storyboard.caption: An explicit opt-in overlay appears, offering 1 credit for playing a 15-second game.
The user plays the Simula interactive mini-game with Luzia for 15 seconds.

callouts.text: Credit is instantly updated to 1 after verification.
The button is now unlocked and ready to export the video.

storyboard.caption: Upon game completion, the credit is granted and the user can generate their AI video animation immediately.
